blocking_findings.summary: The revised plan still cannot complete authenticated acceptance on either no-traffic candidate host.
blocking_findings.evidence: spec.md:89-94 and 166-175 require authenticated candidate flows. plan.md:104 and 157 add the Sales handoff test and implementation. plan.md:172 adds the Marketing implementation, but plan.md:119-123 does not test the Marketing start handoff. plan.md:181-184 adds both promotion gates, consistent with spec.md:142-144. However, the shared client always uses its configured redirect URI for authorization and exchange at packages/auth/src/company-identity/client.ts:303-313,327-339. The bootstrap registers only the production callbacks at apps/accounts/scripts/bootstrap-contract.ts:20-24. Accounts requires an exact client and callback match at packages/backend/src/modules/company-identity/service.ts:529-538. The plan adds no preview callback registration, cross-host session bridge, or equivalent handoff. The candidates therefore cannot receive the callback and host-local session required by acceptance.
